name: Axiom EMS adapter
transport: HTTPS + bearer token supplied by the user
rules: analyst_label may be TP, FP, or null.
reference_explanation is optional and used only for evaluation.
contexts and decision are optional unless evaluating existing EMS decisions.
Each source must be Zenity or Troj. Event and context IDs must be unique.
Return contexts in retrieval rank order, with at most top_k items.
The classifier never receives the analyst_label or reference_explanation fields.
The workspace evaluates one batch of at most 50 events per run; next_cursor is reserved for the adapter.
Allow CORS from the Axiom site origin; allow Content-Type and Authorization headers.
The workspace does not write labels or remediation actions back to EMS.
relevant_context_ids is optional. When supplied it must be the complete analyst-curated set of relevant chunk IDs, including relevant chunks not retrieved. Omit the field when relevance is unknown.
Precision@k uses relevant top-k hits / requested k. Missing returned positions count as misses. Recall@k uses hits / the complete relevant set; empty sets have undefined recall.
Existing EMS decisions use their original retrieved-context count as k.
relevant_context_ids is used for evaluation only and never sent to the classifier.
